input_contract: completed chronological bars; no unfinished or future bar
output_contract: inspectable evidence card; committee and risk remain authoritative

definition.scope: Bounded local model; not the complete original school. Data availability and entry conditions are checked separately.
definition.scope_ar: نموذج محلي محدد القواعد؛ لا يمثل المدرسة الأصلية بكاملها. يجري فحص توفر البيانات وشروط الدخول بشكل منفصل.
rules: Three confirmed alternating pivots; first leg at least 2 ATR, retracement 0.382–0.786, fresh first-leg break within 16 bars with retracement intact.
rules_ar: ثلاثة محاور مؤكدة متناوبة؛ الضلع الأول ضعفا نطاق التقلب على الأقل والتصحيح بين 38.2 و78.6 بالمئة، ثم كسر جديد خلال ست عشرة شمعة مع سلامة قاع أو قمة التصحيح.

contract.promotion_policy: versioned code change plus tests; never automatic self-modification
contract.price_plan: closed-bar entry zone +/- 0.15 ATR; structural stop buffered 0.1 ATR; default 2R or explicit model target
contract.portfolio_authority: independent shared daily risk; no agent may alter limits

theory_scope_ar: نموذج محلي محدد القواعد، وليس المدرسة كاملة: إليوت: فرضية موجتين محلية
rules_python:
def wave12(b,c):
    p=st._alternating_pivots(c["pivots"])[-3:]
    if len(p)<3:return wait(b)
    a,peak,retrace=p;bull=a["kind"]=="LOW";sign=1 if bull else -1
    wave=sign*(peak["price"]-a["price"])
    pullback=sign*(peak["price"]-retrace["price"])
    geometry=wave>=2*c["atr"] and .382<=pullback/wave<=.786 if wave>0 else False
    age=len(b)-1-(retrace["index"]+2)
    intact=all(x["low"]>=retrace["price"] if bull else x["high"]<=retrace["price"] for x in b[retrace["index"]+1:])
    trigger=(b[-2]["close"]<=peak["price"]<b[-1]["close"] if bull else b[-2]["close"]>=peak["price"]>b[-1]["close"])
    active=geometry and 1<=age<=16 and intact and trigger
    result=signal(b,active and bull,active and not bull,retrace["price"],retrace["price"],
                  {"pivots": p,"retracement": pullback/wave if wave>0 else None,"age": age})
    result["assumptions"].append("Local wave 1-2 hypothesis; nested Elliott counts and future wave completion are not asserted")
    return result
execution_note: Implemented rules still require committee, quote, risk and broker approval; this is not a profitability certificate.
